issues.where: the glass at its rim, and the cottage against the left glass
issues.what: the rim has two edges, so the wall has thickness, but the cottage, fence, and tree stay straight and the same size up to the glass. The liquid does not bend or enlarge them. The closer rim crops in set-C-02.jpg and set-C-03.jpg show the same thing
issues.fix: enlarge and bend the interior as it nears the inner wall, the way water in a sphere would

issues.where: the glass at its shoulder, upper right
issues.what: a hard-edged elliptical ring sits on the glass, apart from the soft discs of light behind it. The same shoulder is in set-B-02.jpg
issues.fix: replace the hard ring with a soft stretched reflection of those lights

issues.where: the frost on the inner left glass
issues.what: the ferns repeat along the curve like a flat brush, with little thickness of their own
issues.fix: vary the crystals and give the spines a little thickness and overlap

issues.where: the snow bank where it meets the pond
issues.what: the near bank is smooth like icing, and the water meets it on a hard dry line with no wet edge
issues.fix: break the bank into grains and darken a thin wet margin at the water
